name: Goal-Line Bear vs Heavy Personnel
formation: Bear Front vs Goal-Line Heavy I-Form

summary.motive: Match heavy goal-line personnel with an extra interior body so every gap is two-gapped and no puller or kicker can find a clean block.
summary.keyDefender: NOSE on the zero — he alone erases both A-gaps and frees the linebackers to play downhill
summary.whyItWorks: Five-down interior fronts eliminate angle blocking; the FB lead arrives to find the linebacker already occupying his aiming point.
summary.failureMode: Getting reached: if a combo moves a 4i off the line, the mugged backers are blocked and the goal-line math flips.

beats.title: 1. The Goal-Line Bear Picture
beats.text: A zero-tech nose flanked by double 4i tackles and both ends stacked at 5-technique gives New England five interior-body defenders against five interior blockers — no reach blocks are available anywhere.

beats.title: 2. Mugged Backers Behind the Wall
beats.text: Both inside linebackers stand directly over the A-gaps at 3.4 yards with the safeties bracketing them at 4.5. Every gap inside the tackles is doubled before the ball is snapped.

beats.title: 3. Power Meets the Wall
beats.text: The fullback leads into strong A but WILL has already shot the gap behind the fighting 4i; the tight-end kick is spilled by the squeezing end straight into the forcing safety.

beats.title: 4. Stuffed Short of the Goal
beats.text: The back hits the line to find the nose controlling both A-gaps, four defenders stacking in the hole, and no cutback lane — the Bear package wins its specialty snap.

relations.tell: Five defenders within one yard of the ball with safeties at just 4.5 yards — the okie nickel look spreads its safeties wider and deeper.
